title: CCLE three-view teaching subset: breast and skin cancer cell lines
pairing_unit: Unique CCLE/DepMap cell-line identity across public assays; these profiles are not claimed to be from the same biological aliquot or culture batch.
cohort: All unambiguously matched breast (28) and skin (33) lines with RNA, TMT mass-spectrometry proteomics and LC-MS metabolomics available; no random sample downsampling.

processing: Map proteomic columns to CCLE_Name after removing the _TenPxXX suffix. Exclude cell lines with multiple proteomic sample columns and require exact unique CCLE_Name-to-DepMap_ID metadata mapping.
Inner join all three views by DepMap_ID, then retain all matched breast and skin lines. No nearest-name or fuzzy matching.
Protein teaching pool: unique single gene symbols only; exclude features >50% missing or zero variance; rank by variance over all61 lines without group labels, retain1200.
RNA teaching pool: unique gene symbols only; remove zero-variance features; rank by variance over all61 lines without group labels, retain1200 independently of proteins.
Retain all225 public metabolite columns. This source was already cleaned, batch-corrected and imputed by its authors; zero observed gaps do not imply no original missingness.
Preserve upstream transformed scales. No log transform, z-scoring, new imputation or normalization during extraction. Round exported values to6decimal places; source files remain available for audit.
limitations: Different assays can use different cell stocks, collection times and processing batches; cell-line identity is the unit of integration, not a paired common aliquot.
Tissue-lineage comparisons are descriptive exploratory examples, not a clinical classification experiment.
Protein and RNA high-variance teaching pools were selected independently before classroom filtering; these are reduced, data-selected views rather than whole-omics matrices.
Metabolite source values were already imputed upstream, so original missingness cannot be reconstructed from the supplied file.
